notes.title: ver 2.1.7 update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Some input fields have been changed to make them easier to enter.
[*] Added version number text to menu screen
[/list]

notes.title: Ver 2.1.6 update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added shortcut UI when the mouse is visible on the flight screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck inside buildings when selecting Japan - Tokyo from the position presets.
[*] Changed so that the maximum and minimum values ​​are applied to the input fields of Drone, Advanced, and Rate items on the settings screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where the calibration process would continue even if it was interrupted while simultaneously calibrating 4 axes.
[/list]

notes.title: ver 2.1.5 update
notes.content:
[list]
[]Made it possible to receive input from the DJI Remote3.
[/list]

notes.title: ver 2.1.4 update
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed the bug where the rate was not being saved correctly.
[*]Fixed the bug where decimal points could not be entered in the expo.
[/list]

notes.title: ver 2.1.3 update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changes to the input system to support controllers such as Bluetooth.
[*]  Fixed the bug where the Roll and Yaw settings in the Advanced configuration were swapped.
[/list]

To address the feedback that Bluetooth controllers could not be connected, we primarily made changes to the input system. We apologize for the time it took to implement this support. We will continue to work on supporting as many controllers as possible. Thank you for your continued support of GlobeXplore.

notes.title: version 2.1.2 update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the controller could not connected if the game was started without a controller connected.
[*] Fixed an issue where controllers could not connected when all controllers were disconnected.
[/list]
This time, we have addressed the issue of not being able to reconnect the controller. We are also aware of an issue where some controllers are not connecting, and are currently working on a solution.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused to our players. Thank you for your continued support of GlobeXplore.

notes.title: version 2.1.1 update

[/list]
